title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: We're excited to announce the official release of Spyglass, our innovative new tool designed to empower you with powerful insights and streamline your operations.

title: Complete File Control in the Editor
summary: Effortlessly manage, customize, and interact with all your images and documents directly within the editor, giving you more control over your content than ever before.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap page to discover everything we've shipped, what's coming next, and our exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a smoother workflow with our newly enhanced checkboxes, now larger, easier to click, simple to drag, and beautifully integrated into our modern interface.

title: Enhanced Editor Collaboration
summary: We've upgraded our editor to make collaborating with your team smoother and more intuitive than ever before.

title: Seamless Sharing and Discovery
summary: Effortlessly discover and access all shared ideas and quests, empowering more connected collaboration with your network.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering users with maximum control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's journey.

title: Noeko Goes Global: New Language Support
summary: We're thrilled to announce that Noeko is expanding its horizons to include comprehensive support for a wide array of international languages, making our platform accessible to even more users worldwide.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Stunning Themes
summary: Transform your workspace with an expanded and refined collection of beautiful themes, designed to elevate your aesthetic and productivity.

title: Enhanced Knowledge Constellation
summary: Unlock deeper insights and streamline your workflow with a dynamic Constellation view, featuring advanced filtering by tags and time, alongside clear visibility into all your shared items and collaborators.

title: Dynamic Search Filters and Customizable Compendiums
summary: Discover, filter, and save your most relevant information effortlessly with dynamic search filters and personalized Compendiums, ensuring your valuable knowledge is always at your fingertips.

title: Smarter Ways to Connect Your Ideas
summary: We're introducing dynamic new ways to link and display your notes, making it easier to visualize and interact with your connected ideas and information.

title: Noeko Self-Hosted and Premium Cloud Plans
summary: We are thrilled to launch Noeko's enhanced availability, offering flexible self-hosting options for ultimate control and powerful premium cloud plans designed for diverse user needs.

title: Personalized Time-Aware Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more precise and personalized welcome as we update our greetings to perfectly match the current time of day, enhancing your overall experience.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Manage your content with unprecedented ease by performing quick actions, such as unapplying tags and deleting items, directly from any list view.

title: Unlock a World of Information with Expanded Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate diverse content formats like YouTube videos, websites, and text files, empowering you to gather and interact with all your knowledge in one central hub.
